title: The clip folder handles unwarped samples, missing markup, own, edited and retired clips
description:
As a beatmaker, I want the clip export to handle the samples that are not tidy (no beat grid, no markup, my own clips mixed in), so that exporting never surprises me.

```gherkin
Feature: Clip folder edge cases
  Scenario: A sample with no beat grid exports unwarped clips
    Given a sample "speech.wav" with no beat grid whose automatic markup has one-shots
    When I export the clips of "speech.wav" to "out"
    Then every clip file in "out/speech" is unwarped

  Scenario: A sample without automatic markup writes nothing and says how to get it
    Given a sample "raw.wav", analyzed without markup
    When I export the clips of "raw.wav" to "out"
    Then the export succeeds with nothing written
    And it says "raw.wav has no automatic markup; run: python -m apricity_analyze.markup raw.wav"

  Scenario: Only automatic markup is exported
    Given the sample "Thunderer.wav" also has my clip "riff" and a curated clip "horn-stab"
    When I export the clips of "Thunderer.wav" to "out"
    Then no clip file under "out/Thunderer" is for "riff" or "horn-stab"

  Scenario: An ML clip I edited became mine and is not exported
    Given the sample's clip "loop-2" was edited by me (its source is now "user")
    When I export the clips of "Thunderer.wav" to "out"
    Then no clip file is for "loop-2"

  Scenario: A retired clip is not exported
    Given the library's clip "loop-3" of "Thunderer.mp3" is retired
    When I export the clips of "marine-band/Thunderer.mp3" to "out" with "--library" pointing at the library
    Then no clip file is for "loop-3"
```
